## Shifting the Research Paradigm

Standard research models often treat methodology as a means to an end. We believe the tool is as important as the discovery.

## Why this matters
By capturing the "Methodological Design" phase, CATER prevents the cycle of redundant work and "messy constructs." We provide a home for the instruments and frameworks that usually stay hidden in appendices.
